★ Request
Show Aston Machan
Outfit: Gym clothes (unspecified)

■ Stage Direction
2 seconds of silence

I had intended to ask, "I want to make a contract with you,"
but those were the words that slipped out of my mouth.
Huh?
Before I knew it, my body was moving. Breaking away from the crowd—

The unusually emphasized word strikes a chord.
Surely she doesn't mean it in a physical sense.

She kicks up dirt with her distinctive high-cadence stride.
With every blink, her speed increases.

If one knew nothing, they wouldn't sense anything amiss at all—
Aston Machan wore her unchanging smile.
With no answer reached, the race soon began.

I had intended to ask, "I want to form a contract with you,"
but those were the words that slipped out of my mouth.
Now, entering the final straight! In third place is Aston Machan!

I understood why she had said "Please come watch."
It was backed by her confidence that in a race, she could leave a deeper trace than anyone else.

Crossing the finish line with a commanding 5-length lead!
And what's more... Aston Machan has set a new record time!
In everyone's eyes, for ever and ever...
..."I don't want you to be forgotten."
...Ngh, from here on!
(Murmur...!)

Fufu, wasn't that wonderful performance!
*smug smug*
I even thought that I never wanted it to vanish.

Pop quiz!
Is Machan reflected clearly in your eyes?

Aston Machan enters my field of vision.
Light on her feet, yet so fleeting. I strained my eyes so as not to miss a single frame.
She's also... huh?! She threw a shoe?!

All right, then? We're good? That settles it.
Now then... let me introduce myself properly once more.

I had come to the trials she told me about the other day. Just like the previous mock race,
many Trainers were here with their eyes on Aston Machan.
...Fufu, how lovely. I like that.

...Watching the race,
you thought, "I don't want to let her be forgotten."
Am I really, truly "reflected"?
is Aston Machan.

I've decided.
I will make your eyes my exclusive lens.

Aston Machan closing in from the outside!
From the outside, Aston Machan, Aston Machan!

I'll keep capturing you, and I'll make sure you're reflected in everyone's eyes forever and ever.
I conveyed that to her using every word I had.

...Why did she invite me to today's trials?
In the end, no matter how much I thought about it, I couldn't figure it out.

Her wish is to leave a trace.
As broadly and deeply as possible. Across all of Japan—no, across the entire world.
Pushing through the crowd of people, I headed toward the green turf.
"—The most important thing is a trace. A trace that does not disappear even when gone."
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
Taaaahhhhhh!!
I must not look away—before I knew it, I was driven by that very urge.
She catches the leader, overtakes, and accelerates once more. And then—

That race was intense enough to make me understand instantly.
It was seared into my mind, as if it would never fade.

She's an incredible talent! I'm going to go scout her again after all—
Wait, huh? Strange, she was right here a second ago.

She won't understand what I mean like this.
I panicked, thinking I had to put it into proper words, but the right ones wouldn't come.
...I look forward to working with you.

Oh, she's running this time too.
...That girl is always smiling, isn't she?

The sight of Aston Machan speeding past the goal post
was so overwhelming, so brilliant, and so ephemeral—

*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*... *phew*...
Ehehe.

Gasping for breath, I managed to reach the vicinity of the goal post.
Aston Machan stood there with her usual smile.

S-Seriously...?! 
She ran at that speed even after throwing a shoe...?! That girl is unreal!
Hmm. Hmm, hmm.

Aston Machan remained calm.
She watched for her chance, biding her time for the exact right moment. And then—
—Aston Machan bursts out with a brilliant dash!
